subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `memory status` report builtin vector-store readiness from persisted `vectorDims` metadata while `--deep` remains the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but it changes the operator-facing and JSON status contract for existing indexed setups, so maintainer intent should settle the semantics before merge.

options.title: Accept metadata-backed fast status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report a previous successful vector index from metadata without probing sqlite-vec in that process.

options.title: Require live-probe wording
options.body: Revise the status output or JSON shape if `ready` must mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability rather than persisted index readiness.

options.title: Pause for another contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want a different canonical status model.

recommendation.title: Accept metadata-backed fast status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report a previous successful vector index from metadata without probing sqlite-vec in that process.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the memory-core vector metadata/status contract where the feature-history trail is strongest.
